channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Milky Way object accelerates protons to record energy levels
item.description: Scientists identified LHAASO J1912+1014u as a cosmic accelerator pushing protons beyond one quadrillion electron volts, offering new insights.

item.title: Cancer may damage its own DNA to sustain growth
item.description: Cancer cells rely on genetic switches to keep growth genes active, but this intense activity can harm their own DNA.

item.title: Dark matter's hidden force behaves unexpectedly, scientists find
item.description: Dark matter particles may interact through a hidden force, but its effects are surprising. An extra attraction helps them cluster, contrary to predictions.

item.title: Mathematicians prove perfect election fairness is unattainable
item.description: Mathematicians have proven that no electoral system can simultaneously achieve local representation, proportional national results, and a fixed-size parliament.
